title: Location native qualification and blockers
summary: Prototype: dev1 WorldModel 17/17 synthetic native checks from prior handoff; dev2 local WorldResolver 13/13 synthetic checks and independent compact spatial slice 6/6 on ooRexx r13196. Only compact spatial slice submitted to Git autobuilder. No PASS receipt yet, nor integration with genuine source datasets.
invariants: Status is LOCAL_PASS or FIXTURE_PASS, never FIELD_PASS without a deployed acceptance receipt.
Autobuilder stopped historically; a ready marker is only submission, not qualification.
Do not claim 40-country provider coverage, physically overlapping sovereign territory, real-world height observations, spatial index or production persistence.

Regression gates: grid cell precision; unknown/rough time; historical jurisdiction; three-country journey order; Cyprus synthetic simultaneous overlays; ambiguous names; provenance; unsupported CRS; no fabricated exact border entry time.

Plan next: compile and include full dev1+dev2 object graph in versioned autobuild package; adapter qualification against IntentionService, SLAM and selected database; independently validate boundaries and historical datasets.
